title: sedum rupestre subsp. forsterianum
intro: Sedum rupestre subsp. forsterianum, commonly known as Forster's Stonecrop, is a succulent plant species belonging to the Crassulaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and supporting wound healing due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Forster's Stonecrop include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
